test_title: PYST 158: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Feb, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'MOVE' is written as 'NQWG' and 'RUST' is written as 'SWTV'. How will 'TASK' be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f731516950ecad0b22519a124606b87907aaeb5ee088df92d84e94129ca01f3.png] ​

**Logic: '1' and '2' are added alternatively to the positional value of the alphabet.**

'MOVE' is written as 'NQWG' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cd6b8cb1c082a568f5e9fd26f4aba80a4c4e7e1e2b97439086535dada16fce4.png] 

'RUST' is written as 'SWTV' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7f756268355d6089039bae6e6e9e1bb83b0e4f7a59e85c97c2c6f991133a589.png] 

Similarly, 'TASK' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d96845c0d7bdcd18b43fc1f1be91627826a823d999fda3db2f22eddb0efe922d.png] 

Here, 'TASK' is written as **'UCTM'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
